_comment: Referents that never become a word at all -- a pack author's hard fence (design 8.4), checked at
derivation rather than at resolution so a forbidden thing is honestly absent instead of silently
dropped. Distinct from `withheld`, which is a timing fence on things that DO become writable later.
Deretheni is here because 7.7 makes it load-bearing: the material is placed by danger, and a writer
who could name 'an Age full of it' would have 8.4's duplication exploit with no danger required. You
cause the conditions; you cannot ask for the outcome. It is the one thing in this phase that must
never become sayable, so it goes in the fence the same day the block exists.
